translation: Took place in posad Serock, 28 November 1890 (no hour stated). Appeared personally Mordka Kanarek, carter, 31, and Szymel [unclear: Ickowicz/Cukowicz], carter, 38, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday died a child of female sex named Rojza Bornsztejn, one year old, daughter of Jankel and Szyfra nee Polkowicz. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of Rojza Bornsztejn this act was read to the witnesses and signed [by us]; the witnesses are illiterate.
